```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
#Importing cleaned_canada
data <- read_csv('cleaned_canada.csv')
head(data)
```

```{r}
#start filtering and summarizing data
housing <- data|>
  filter(City == 'Vancouver')|>
  select(Latitude, Longitude, Price, Bedrooms, Bathrooms, `Property Type`, `Square Footage`, Garage, Pool, Garden)|>
  rename(Type = `Property Type`, Sqft = `Square Footage`)
  
glimpse(housing)
summary(housing)
```
```{r}
#importing public parks and arts
parks<-read_csv2('parks-polygon-representation.csv')|>
  select(`Park Name`, geo_point_2d)|>
  separate(col = geo_point_2d, into = c('Latitude', 'Longitude'), sep = ',', convert = TRUE, remove = TRUE)|>
  rename(park_name = `Park Name`)
art<-read_csv2('public-art.csv')|>
  rename(name = `Title of Work`)|>
  filter(!is.na(Geom))|>
  mutate(longitude = vapply(Geom, function(x) {
      jsonlite::fromJSON(x)$coordinates[1]
    }, numeric(1)),
    latitude = vapply(Geom, function(x) {
      jsonlite::fromJSON(x)$coordinates[2]
    }, numeric(1))
  )|>
  select(name, longitude, latitude)
head(art)
head(parks)
```
```{r}
#distance to parks
sf_use_s2(TRUE)
housing_sf <- st_as_sf(housing, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
parks_sf <- st_as_sf(parks, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
art_sf <- st_as_sf(art, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
nearest_park <- st_nearest_feature(housing_sf, parks_sf)
nearest_art <- st_nearest_feature(housing_sf, art_sf)
distance_park <- st_distance(housing_sf, 
                        parks_sf[nearest_park, ], 
                        by_element = TRUE)
distance_art <- st_distance(housing_sf, 
                            art_sf[nearest_art, ],
                            by_element = TRUE)
housing$nearest_park <- parks_sf$park_name[nearest_park]
housing$distance_park <- as.numeric(units::set_units(distance_park, 'm'))
housing$nearest_art <- art_sf$name[nearest_art]
housing$distance_art <- as.numeric(units::set_units(distance_art, 'm'))
head(housing)
```
